evidence.reason: Line 94 creates the fixture commit without disabling inherited commit signing. If the developer or CI environment has global `commit.gpgSign=true`, Git attempts to sign with the fixture identity and can fail when no matching key exists, causing every `DeployFixture` test to error in `setUp()`. Setting repository-local `commit.gpgSign=false` before the first commit is a minimal hermetic fix; the supplied code has no such setting.
